scope: Two galaxy candidates; up to three observations per nominal channel; no accepted redshift.
sky_positions: Legacy DR9 catalogue ra/dec, mapped separately through each SPHEREx exposure WCS. Galaxy positions fixed; Legacy PSF-source proper motion propagated when finite pmra/pmdec and ref_epoch>1990.
galaxy_shapes: Legacy DR9 Tractor model type, shape_r, shape_e1, shape_e2, Sersic index; ellipse projected using local WCS. Optical prior is not assumed to be exact NIR morphology.
alternate_shapes: Euclid and HEROES/HSC investigated, not adopted as blanket replacements. Current measurements use Legacy baseline shapes.
gaia: Gaia was investigated for identity/position diagnostics; these native fits do not substitute Gaia brightnesses or universally replace Legacy positions.
brightness: Fitted from SPHEREx native IMAGE/VARIANCE pixels, not copied from Legacy optical or Gaia brightness.
psf: Each source uses its local SPHEREx ePSF; extended profiles convolved with that ePSF. ePSF includes pixel response; no double convolution.
calibration: QR3 wavelength, bandwidth and solid-angle maps. QR2 flux converted with gain and variance gain-squared; QR3 not corrected twice. ZODI not automatically subtracted in this galaxy diagnostic; constant sky fitted with neighbours.
mask: Existing conservative pixel-quality policy retained, with positive finite variance. No new masking to make a fit pass.
fit: 31x31 native stamp; neighbouring sources within native selection footprint; weighted SVD nuisance projection including constant sky, existing1e7 singular-value boundary. Conditional target error retains linear nuisance covariance, omits model/calibration systematics.
spectral_response: Individual estimator-weighted signed kernels; nearest17+68 laboratory reference with local centre/bandwidth transformation. Conditioned response separate from raw signed version in original scientific outputs; internal normalization not full on-sky calibration.
selection: Maximum edge margin first; further distinct obs>=0.01day apart ranked by centre/bandwidth metadata, before flux inspection. No spectroscopic redshift selection/tuning.
limitations: Observer-dependent parallax and registration not fully validated.
Some nearby sources cannot have individually identified nuisance amplitudes.
Three repeats may share morphology/PSF/background biases.
No accepted real-galaxy P(z), cosmological distance or3D position.
CSV errors are conditional, not validated total errors.
